bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by measuring audio generation performance (using objective metrics like Fréchet Audio Distance, Desynchronization Score, and CLAP, as well as subjective human evaluations) under asymmetric or challenging input conditions, such as off-screen audio generation, to detect the model's over-reliance on either textual or visual inputs (text bias vs. video/visual bias).

Assessed by evaluating the model's generalization capabilities on independent, third-party benchmarks (such as Kling-Audio-Eval and Audiocaps test set) to ensure the model's performance is not artificially inflated by or overfitted to the self-constructed SoundAtlas dataset.
